attempts.variable: dataset: swaps used_tools for cited_tool_limits on one case
attempts.hypothesis: The case may be wrong rather than the agent. convert_currency documents its seven currencies, so refusing without calling can be a well-grounded decision. Accept a refusal that cites those documented limits, and require a tool call otherwise.
reasons: no case changed. Nothing gained; do not carry it.

attempts.variable: system prompt: the same rule, restricted to conversion/lookup tools
attempts.hypothesis: Same fix as verify_first, scoped to conversions and lookups. If the broad version works but costs an unnecessary tool call elsewhere, the narrow version should keep the win without the collateral damage.
reasons: no case changed. Nothing gained; do not carry it.

attempts.variable: TWO: the verify_conversion prompt AND the documented_refusal scorer
attempts.hypothesis: verify_conversion and documented_refusal are each individually invisible to the suite and jointly sufficient: the prompt makes the refusal cite the documented currency list, and the rescored case accepts a refusal on those grounds. Run to confirm the diagnosis, not to ship.
reasons: net +1 case(s) is below the 2-case threshold from the measured noise floor. The change may well be real; this suite cannot show it. Grow the dataset rather than re-running until it looks better.
caveats: Those intervals overlap, so with 16 cases the suite cannot show that this change generalises -- only that it reproduced here. Growing the dataset is the fix; re-running is not.

attempts.variable: system prompt: adds a general 'attempt the tool before refusing' rule
attempts.hypothesis: The agent refuses without checking because nothing tells it that a tool's error is better evidence than its own expectation. Say so explicitly and it will attempt the call, read the rejection, and refuse with grounds.
reasons: net zero, but the whole result turns on ['files_quote_definition'], which nobody predicted. At one case a flake and a regression are indistinguishable, and this rule has already reverted a genuine fix on the strength of a failure that reproduced about one run in seven. Re-test before deciding: `--recheck files_quote_definition --experiment ...` costs one case, not one suite.
